The '''Sundari Research Grounds''' was a scientific research facility located in the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] [[Arick Tamso]] and [[Tabo]] worked at the facility before [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] overtook the compound.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sundar Research Grounds appear in the Republic version of Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The area's world-map name is mislabeled as the "Sundar Research Grounds," though mission text and other text elements confirm the correct name.
